name: comp-204
title: Select With Placeholder
blurb: Select dropdown with placeholder text prompting user choice.
description: Basic Select with Label, SelectTrigger with placeholder text, and SelectContent with four framework options. No default value.
use_when: You need a select that prompts users to make an explicit choice.
avoid_when: When a sensible default exists; use comp-203 instead.
a11y: Label linked via htmlFor. Placeholder guides user interaction. Full keyboard navigation.
